scenarios.user: Operator preparing a release of one target
scenarios.goal: Get the notes of the next Release of a scope and know they are complete
scenarios.prerequisites: A checkout with the scope's history; for --check, the tag created locally at the commit
steps: Replace every <fill in> and trim the change list
scenarios.expected: The draft names the full SHA, the tag, the previous release and the merged pull requests under android/; --check prints 'android/v2.0.0-rc.1: notes complete'
scenarios.failure: An unknown scope, a bad version, a used tag, a version not above a contained release, a --from that is no ancestor or a missing previous release ends with status 2 and a message; --check without --tag ends with status 2; unfilled fields, notes of another tag or commit, or a tag at another commit make --check fail with status 1

scenarios.goal: Take a commit to a signed, checked APK and a tagged candidate by following the runbook
scenarios.prerequisites: python3, the Android SDK and JDK 17; a directory with the two private inputs, the release keystore, the installed store release's APK
steps: Run release CI for the full SHA and the manual gates

android/tools/release/export_candidate.py <full SHA> <new directory> --private <directory> && (cd <new directory>/android && tools/release/gradle-release.sh && zipalign -c ... && apksigner sign ... && tools/release/check-apk.sh <signed> <store>)
Device gate, then local tag, notes check, push and pre-release
scenarios.expected: The export holds the commit's android/ files byte for byte and the two private inputs, whatever the checkout or the shell holds; the build takes its inputs from private.properties; check-apk prints ok for each check and the identity lines
scenarios.failure: An unknown commit, an existing directory, a tree with a symbolic link or an export that does not read back as the commit stops before the build; a Gradle init script stops the build; a wrong key, a versionCode that is not higher, a debuggable APK, the sample AdMob ID or a build without Firebase makes check-apk fail; the candidate ends and the next one starts at step 1

scenarios.user: Operator or agent verifying a release commit
scenarios.goal: Know that a named commit passed the slow, exact checks
scenarios.prerequisites: The workflow on master; gh authenticated
steps: gh workflow run android-release.yml --ref master -f ref=<full SHA>
scenarios.expected: PR checks, release lint and the device suites on API 36, API 24, tablet and foldable emulators pass; 'Verified commit' names the SHA
scenarios.failure: A failed or skipped device test, an adb that failed, a lint error or a ref that is not the full SHA of the checked-out commit fails the run; the suite summary shows every failed suite

scenarios.user: Contributor opening an Android pull request
scenarios.goal: Get the merge checks within minutes
scenarios.expected: The two existing jobs run and finish within the measured 2-10 minutes; no emulator job is part of the pull request
scenarios.failure: A failing JVM test or a stale snapshot fails the pull request as before

scenarios.user: Maintainer adding a CI check to any target
scenarios.goal: Decide whether the check belongs to PR CI or release CI
scenarios.expected: The rules decide the tier, and the row names the workflows and whether the target is within the PR time
scenarios.failure: A check needing a private input, a phone or store access is a manual gate of the runbook, in neither tier
